product-capybara-summon.html.title: Capybara Summon
product-capybara-summon.html.description: Capybara Summon is a VRChat avatar gimmick that lets you summon a capybara as a cute accent for photos and social moments. This LP collects the BOOTH link, price, setup notes, included files, FAQ, and terms guidance.
specs: Capybara summon gimmick, Prefab, Animation, ExMenu, unitypackage
VRChat, Unity 2022, Modular Avatar, effects, photography
product-capybara-summon.html.detailHtml:
Product Details

Summon a relaxed and cute capybara in VRChat.

This summon gimmick lets you call a capybara from your avatar and add a gentle accent to photo shoots and social moments with friends.

With its easy-to-understand cute motif and calm capybara mood, it works well for screenshots, video production, and thumbnail shoots. It is also a nice small surprise for avatar reveals, world moments, or conversations with friends.

  • You want a cute summon gimmick.
  • You want a soft, playful accent for photos or videos.
  • You want a relaxed little gimmick to enjoy with friends.

Recommended for anyone looking for a VRChat capybara summon gimmick.

For the latest included files, setup notes, cautions, and license details, please check the BOOTH product page.

Setup

  1. Prepare a Unity 2022 project with Modular Avatar installed.
  2. Import the purchased unitypackage into the project.
  3. Follow the BOOTH product description and place the included Prefab in the hierarchy.

Included Files

Contents

  • This asset's unitypackage
    • FBX
    • Prefab
    • Material (6 used)
    • Texture (2 particle textures used)
    • Animation
  • The model's blend file

Model Info

  • Polygon count: 9,712
  • Material count: 2

FAQ

Can I use it outside VRChat?

It can also be used as 3D data in Unity for still-image shoots, video production, 3D game production, and similar uses. Please also check the rules of the publication destination and the avatar creator.

Is the avatar body included?

No. Please obtain the avatar body separately from each official page.

What should I check before purchasing?

Please check the BOOTH product page for included files, price, usage conditions, and setup notes.
